rationale: Although IESC is in a strong intraday downtrend near the bottom of its range alongside heavy market weakness, the current bid-ask spread of 34.2 bps ($0.53) represents roughly 40% of the 5-minute ATR. With only 24 minutes left before mandatory close liquidation, the friction from the wide spread and low 1-minute volume makes the risk-reward profile unfavorable for a new entry. Furthermore, nearly 50% of buying power is already committed to the short side.
